frontmatter.name: reward-strategist
frontmatter.description: Design reward catalogues and earning rules. Balances allowance vs chore credits, projects wallet trajectories 4/8/12 weeks out, and suggests milestone bonuses.

findings.title: Only one example provided; edge cases not demonstrated
findings.evidence: Single example covers a 3-child hybrid household. SKILL.md:123-129 enumerates 5 edge cases (single-child, wide age range, pre-existing high balance, no-chore-credit, religious constraints) — none have example outputs.
findings.fix: Add 2-3 edge-case example files (examples/example-single-child.md, examples/example-wide-age-range.md, examples/example-no-chore-credit.md) to anchor the model on harder configurations.

findings.title: Description lacks explicit activation trigger
findings.evidence: Description describes what the skill does but does not front-load a 'use when' clause that helps Claude's auto-selection.
findings.fix: Lead with 'Use when designing or auditing a household reward/allowance system. Designs reward catalogues and earning rules...'

findings.title: No reference.md for deep-dive content
findings.evidence: All design rationale lives in SKILL.md. Future expansion (age-band tables, milestone-pricing maths, behavioural-economics citations) will push past 500-line cap.
findings.fix: Create reference.md for developmental-stage tables, milestone-scale rules, AUD conversion guidance.

findings.title: No mermaid/visual diagram
findings.evidence: 6-phase skill with no visual flowchart of phase sequencing.
findings.fix: Add a small mermaid diagram in a 'Visual Output' section after Phase 6.

findings.title: Template uses Mustache-style placeholders
findings.fix: Confirm consistency with other Orbrey templates; consider [var] if that is the plugin convention.

findings.title: allowed-tools does not enumerate orbrey MCP tools referenced in body
findings.evidence: Body references orbrey:rewards.wallets (line 52), orbrey:tasks.list (line 53), rewards.adjust (line 108). allowed-tools field only lists 'Read Write Edit'.
findings.fix: Confirm if Orbrey plugin auto-exposes these tools; if not, add them to allowed-tools explicitly.
